name: instant-worker — flow_test latency regression [synthetic flow slow but correct]
description: P2 on a synthetic flow whose P95 end-to-end latency crosses 5s over 30m. The synthetic runner records latencyMs on every InstantFlowTest event (and the instant_flow_test_latency_seconds histogram). A flow that still passes but has slowed past its budget is a latency regression in the api / provision path — investigate alongside the api latency dashboards, do not page. The per-flow budgets are 1s (healthz), 2s (auth_me), 10s (provision_reap); 5s is a platform-wide P95 floor that catches a real slowdown while tolerating the provision→reap leg's normal multi-second round-trip. INERT until FLOW_SYNTHETIC_ENABLED=true. Source: worker/internal/jobs/flow_synthetic.go.

nrql.query: SELECT percentile(latencyMs, 95) FROM InstantFlowTest WHERE cohort = 'synthetic' FACET flow
